convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'JFatl_Digit_System' custom indicator with multiple buffers and custom parameters; includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, money management, and order execution; signal logic depends on custom indicator color buffer values (Col[1]>2, Col[0]<3) which are non-standard

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - timeframe duration in seconds for signal time calculation
min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position: buy signal closes sell, sell signal closes buy, controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots at 0.1, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) serves as either fixed lot size or percentage depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: Signal logic reads buffer index 6 (color/trend state buffer) of the custom JFatl_Digit_System indicator. Col[1]>2 indicates bullish state (value>2 on previous bar), Col[0]<3 confirms transition (value<3 on signal bar) for buy entry. Col[1]<2 indicates bearish state, Col[0]>1 confirms transition for sell entry. These are discrete color/trend state codes, not continuous values. When SignalBar=0, the EA evaluates every tick without new-bar guard. The Recount flag retries signal calculation on CopyBuffer failure. GlobalVariableDel_ in deinitialization cleans up global variables used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position tracking.
python_conversion_notes: The custom indicator JFatl_Digit_System must be reimplemented in Python or its buffer values pre-computed and stored. The indicator combines JMA (Jurik Moving Average) with FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) and digit filtering, which is non-trivial to replicate. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions that must be reimplemented. The money management logic (MarginMode enum with 5 modes) must be ported carefully. Signal logic uses integer color codes from buffer 6 (not standard price/crossover logic) so exact indicator replication is mandatory. SL/TP values (1000/2000) appear to be in points not pips - verify against broker digit configuration. The LoadHistory call ensures historical data availability for SeriesInfoInteger.
